about: La Malbaie is a city in Charlevoix, Quebec, on a wide bay of the St. Lawrence, including neighbourhoods such as Pointe-au-Pic. Resort heritage at the Manoir Richelieu, casino tourism, and cliff-and-river scenery define this regional centre. About 8,000 people live in La Malbaie.
seoSummary: Charlevoix city on a St. Lawrence bay—Manoir Richelieu, casino, and Pointe-au-Pic resort heritage.
